import json,os
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('store/jobs/j000053/out/file.0xab0b138cf350.0xab0b1052da20.SharedCacheMap.app.asar.vacb')

 hits=[]
 for enc in (t.encode(),t.encode('utf-16le')):
  start=0

   i=b.find(enc,start)
   if i<0:break
   hits.append(i); start=i+1
 out['checks'][t]={'count':len(hits),'offsets':hits[:40]}
Path(os.environ['OUT'],'asar-cache-keyword-offsets.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
